slice 2 reel-native: WorkerMfAacProvider (feature mf) = reel ExternalAudioDecoder over reel-native-mf-worker --aac: OS Microsoft AAC Audio Decoder MFT {32D186A7-218F-4C75-8876-DD77273A8999} (first synchronous software AAC decoder MFT), raw access units in (HEAACWAVEINFO user data + ASC), float PCM out, reordered from the WAVE channel mask to the AAC element order (C L R Ls Rs LFE for 5.1); admission before any spawn (1-8 ch, 7350-96000 Hz, config 1-7, ASC 2-64 bytes); wire AUDIO kind (tag, channels, rate, f32) checked by the pool (declared channels and rate, sent tag, <= 64 per batch) else counted worker_protocol; generic pool exchange_any + RawSession shared with the encoder

slice 3 reel: os_encode module: ExternalVideoEncoder / VideoEncodeSession / OsEncodeSpec / EncodedUnit / OsVideoSettings (bitrate, H264Profile); ExportQueue::with_video_encoder; VideoCodecChoice::H264 / Hevc (output-module formats); refusals before the first frame and before any worker: no encoder (MEDIA_CODEC_UNAVAILABLE h264/hevc), non-8-bit-4:2:0 (os-encode-pixel-format), odd or zero sides (os-encode-dimensions), bitrate outside 1..=400 Mbit/s, frame rate not a u32 rational; Annex B -> 4-byte length samples with SPS/PPS(/VPS) and AUDs moved to avcC / hvcC built from the first key unit (build_avcc incl. High-profile extension; build_hvcc from SPS profile_tier_level, chroma, bit depths), parameter-set change refused; unit presenting a not-yet-sent frame or a non-key first unit = decoder_protocol; mux VideoEntry::Hevc (hvc1 + hvcC, parse_hvcc) and avc1 for OS output

slice 3 reel-native: WorkerMfEncoder (NEW default-off feature os-encode = mf, no new dependency) over reel-native-mf-worker --encode=h264|hevc: first synchronous software encoder MFT, output type first then NV12 input (I420 -> NV12 in pure nv12.rs), frame-rate / bitrate / profile / progressive / square pixels; coded units tagged with the frame they present: output-time offset learned from the first key unit (the Microsoft H.264 Encoder MFT stamps B-frame output one frame late, measured), then exact, then nearest within one frame; HEVC where no encoder: MEDIA_CODEC_UNAVAILABLE hevc (HELLO version unavailable|no-sync-software-hevc-encoder-mft|hw=n|async=n). Host presence: H264 Encoder MFT {6CA50344-051A-4DED-9779-A43305165E35} and HEVCVideoExtensionEncoder (Microsoft.HEVCVideoExtension 2.5.48.0 installed, packaged MFT, CLSID reported as zero GUID) both PRESENT on this host
